He offered me a 20.000‚Ç¨ loan for a trading account, he said the account will grow to 70.000‚Ç¨, he said we can make this money by trading on the forex market which I have to pay once when the account reaches the target of 70.000‚Ç¨. So, I agreed with it. They started to trade on the account and gave me weekly updates by phone. Within two months they reached the target of 73.000‚Ç¨, I was ready to pay the 20.000‚Ç¨ to secure the account but I didn‚Äôt have the money to cover the loan for the account. Donald told me he can talk to the financial department to see if I can get a discount.  I started to get 10.000‚Ç¨ together, I reached out to one of my friends and he agreed to pay some money on it so we can have this account. I sent 3000CAD through my BitBuy account.
